facts.label: Local time matters
facts.description: Flight departure and arrival times are normally shown in the local time of each airport. Crossing time zones can make the clock difference unlike the flight duration.

facts.label: Direct and nonstop are different
facts.description: A nonstop flight has no intermediate stops. A direct flight can stop along the way while keeping the same flight number.

facts.label: Three letters, one airport
facts.description: IATA airport codes use three letters. Cities with several airports can have multiple airport codes, so check the airport as well as the city.
